title: Gauge-Invariant Dressed Thermodynamics of Ultrastrong-Coupling Mito-Polaritons: Virtual-Photon Passivity, Positive Zero-Point Energy Shifts, and Dipole-vs-Coulomb Dark-Mode Invariance
abstract: Continuing ARR-2025-2AQXS44H6Z8GQAG2 and ARR-2026-1E91AXEJYT890TQC, we derive the exact gauge-invariant dressed quantum thermodynamics of ultrastrong-coupling (eta = 1264/6177 approx 0.2046) 71/87-THz mitochondrial cristae polaritons (unrefereed preprint bioRxiv:10.64898/2026.09.10.750628v1). Backed by MITO-USC-DRESSED-THERMO-CERT-1.0 (18 constructive Lean 4.36.0 integer/rational theorems with -DwarningAsError=true, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice; 16 exact-Q certificates C01-C16; and 26 adversarial tests), we establish: (i) detuning-universal positive Hopfield A^2 ZPE shift (nu_+ + nu_-)^2 = (omega_c + omega_0)^2 + 4g^2, giving Delta E_ZPE = (128/71) h*THz approx 7.456 meV per mode (crossing 15 k_B T at M=54 modes as an order-of-magnitude Helfrich scale benchmark); (ii) exact resonant 4x4 symplectic diagonalization giving n_virt = 64/6177 approx 0.01036 (> 5180x bare 87-THz thermal occupation at 310 K), squeezing 6177/6305, marginal entanglement det(2 V_a) > 1, and <G|H_int+H_A2|G>=0; (iii) exact passivity W_erg(|G>, H_C)=0 and C_Delta(|G>)=0 vs naive bare-basis heating exceeding the true dressed lower-polariton KMS upward rate exp(-beta*h*nu_-) by > 610x (~615x at 71 THz, ~477x at 79 THz, ~502x at 65 THz); (iv) PZW canonical weight swap (7569/12610 <-> 5041/12610) with gauge-invariant single-branch dipole transition element omega_0*nu_-/(omega_0^2+nu_-^2) = 6177/12610 and invariant (N-1)-dimensional dark manifold; and (v) collective single-mode ZPE ceiling > 2.9x the 2.546 meV +10% turnover barrier, qualified by 1/N dilution across N=10^6-10^8 uncorrelated dipoles.
